- Initial release of macos-connectivity-restore.
- Restores Universal Control and AirDrop settings on managed Macs by resetting relevant managed preference files.
- Sets AirDrop discoverability to "Contacts Only."
- Includes scripts to fix settings at both root and user levels.
- Optionally installs startup items to persist fixes across reboots.
